description: The shipped contribution resolver in a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose resolution policy names the shipped layered resolver, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template beside a consumer crate that installs the resolver statically, with no plugin loader. The exercise pins that loading without the resolver installed fails closed with the resolver-not-installed code, that the plain generated reader leaves contributions as records, that reader_with_contribution_resolver settles each target under the declared layer precedence into resolution items after the documents, and that a record naming a target no record contributes fails the reading with the resolution-failed code and no resolution item
